response.overview: # Untitled  It tells the story of Afnan Tasneem (Mira Filzah) and Dr. Syed Nadzhan (Aliff Aziz) who have just become husband and wife. Nevertheless, their happiness is only temporary. The couple's marriage begins to be tested when Nadzhan is forced to cooperate with an enchanting female doctor named Dr. Sandra (Alicia Amin) for a research project in their laboratory. Meanwhile, the situation becomes more complicated when Tasneem receives a letter from the woman most despised by Nadzhan—his own mother (Haliza Misbun). After being absent for a long time, Nadzhan's mother wishes to reunite with her son. Out of a sense of responsibility as a wife, Tasneem is determined to reunite the mother and son who have been separated for so long, despite Nadzhan's reluctance. Tasneem realizes that her plan is not at all appreciated by her husband. Because she wants to see Nadzhan happy, Tasneem must endure the pain in her heart and tolerate her husband's whims, which grow more intense with Dr.
